component.name: INZONE Buds Mixer
component.summary: Control the native Game, Chat and microphone endpoints on Linux

description.p: INZONE Buds Mixer is an unofficial open-source controller for the Sony INZONE Buds USB dongle in PC mode. It adjusts the native Game and Chat balance, overall playback level and microphone level through PipeWire.
This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony. INZONE and Sony are trademarks of their respective owner.

developer.name: Sony INZONE Buds for Linux contributors

description.p: Adds Arch Linux packaging and fixes a Boost Chat bug.

ul.li: Fix Boost Chat sometimes setting Game to 100% instead of 30%
Boost Chat no longer overwrites a manual balance change on deactivation

description.p: Adds a Boost Chat preset, desktop notifications, a user config file and CI.

ul.li: Boost Chat toggle: sets Game 30%/Chat 70%, restores the prior volumes on a second press
Desktop notification when the dongle connects or disconnects
User config file for optional behavior, without editing scripts
Start at login in the tray
Automated tests, ShellCheck and metadata validation on every change

description.p: First release of INZONE Buds Mixer.

ul.li: Overall volume, Game/Chat balance and microphone controls, with a Center button
Tray icon with Show Window, Center Game/Chat and Quit
Volume and mute keys move Game and Chat together, keeping their balance
Immediate updates when volumes change outside the mixer

description.p: Command-line and WirePlumber integration for the native Game, Chat and microphone endpoints.
